tone_patterns: Formal, standards-led tone that foregrounds compliance and alignment with named frameworks
Assurance-oriented language emphasizing consistency, consolidation principles, and comparability
Forward-looking commitment statements framed as continuous improvement rather than definitive claims
Neutral, process-focused phrasing that avoids promotional adjectives and keeps emphasis on methodology
paragraph_patterns: Opens with a short compliance declaration referencing the governing standards for the report
Follows with a scoping paragraph that identifies which parts of the standard are applicable to operations
Includes a cross-referencing paragraph that links this report to other sustainability-related publications and frameworks
Uses a directive sentence pointing readers to an appendix for a complete disclosure index or reference set
Introduces a materiality refresh/update with a time anchor, then explains purpose and stakeholder scope
Presents the assessment method as a stepwise process using bullet points
Adds a methodology context paragraph describing guiding inputs (regulation, frameworks, benchmarks, peer practices)
Describes stakeholder engagement mechanics (e.g., survey) and what it was designed to capture
Summarizes outputs at a high level (e.g., priority areas) and indicates where detailed results will be published
Closes with policy/approach statements on consistency of accounting policies and consolidation approach, then a continuous-improvement commitment
heading_patterns: Numbered subsection headings (e.g., X.X) with concise titles that match IFRS disclosure concepts (e.g., compliance, materiality)
Headings appear as clear anchors separating compliance statements from methodology and outcomes
Section transitions signposted by the next numbered heading at the end of the excerpt
table_patterns: Compact list-style presentation of applicable standard components (e.g., volumes/industry modules) formatted as multi-line blocks
Use of short labels with line breaks to fit narrow column widths (e.g., splitting long descriptors across lines)
Two-column categorical listing for stakeholder groups (internal vs external) presented as parallel lists
Topic/priority outputs displayed as a simple grid or tile-like list of short phrases rather than narrative paragraphs
figure_or_diagram_patterns: Tile/grid layout used to present key themes or priority areas as discrete labeled blocks
Stakeholder mapping presented as grouped lists under category headers, visually separated for quick scanning
pdf_layout_patterns: Section header repeated as a running header or page header element
Use of whitespace and line breaks to create scannable blocks for lists and framework references
Bulleted lists with hanging indents; occasional wrapped lines for long bullet text
Interleaving narrative paragraphs with visual list blocks (tiles/grids) to break up dense compliance text
Footer includes page number and report title/year line; consistent placement across pages
Appendix references embedded inline as navigational cues (e.g., 'Refer to Appendix X.X')
disclosure_language_patterns: Explicit statement of adherence to specific standards using 'follows'/'aligned with' constructions
Applicability language indicating scoping decisions (e.g., identifying which standard components apply)
Cross-report linkage language indicating where related disclosures can be found in other publications
Methodology disclosure phrased as 'process included' followed by enumerated steps
Consistency language covering accounting policies, comparative figures, and consolidation principles
Commitment language framed as ongoing enhancement of materiality approach and disclosures
evidence_presentation_patterns: Evidence is presented through references to recognized frameworks, guidelines, and prior reports rather than detailed data in-text
Method evidence provided via description of assessment steps and stakeholder engagement mechanism
Traceability supported by directing readers to an appendix containing a consolidated disclosure set/index
Outcome evidence summarized at a high level with indication of where full results will be published
section_specific_observations: The section blends compliance declaration, reporting ecosystem cross-references, and materiality methodology in one continuous narrative
Materiality is framed using a dual lens (impact and financial/enterprise value) and tied to risk/opportunity management
The excerpt uses multiple list formats (bullets, grouped lists, tiles) to present scoping, stakeholders, and priority themes
things_to_avoid_copying: Any organization name, report titles, or branded program/report names
Any specific framework list as a fixed set; treat framework references as configurable to the reporting entity
Any explicit year references, edition labels, or publication timing statements
Any specific stakeholder titles, committee names, or internal role labels
Any specific industry module/volume numbers or sector-specific applicability claims
Any specific list of priority topics/themes as presented in the excerpt
content_specific_items_detected_and_excl: Specific IFRS S2 industry volume identifiers and titles
Named external frameworks, guidelines, regulators, and exchanges
References to specific other reports and their publication years
Specific stakeholder group labels and role titles
Specific list of priority sustainability topics/themes
Specific year/time markers and report edition references
Page number and report title/year footer text
